title: anatomic-pathology-tissue
html:
Tissue processing and imaging in diseases

High variability in tissue processing between the different labs makes the translation of the experimental results into the clinic very difficult. We aim to provide assistance in using standardized protocols for processing and imaging of different organs. Our protocols can be adapted and optimized by our highly experienced staff to apply to any pathological condition.
